]> 03/08/2026 7:17 Snow in the forecast!.

We're kicking off the week at Perisher with snow in the forecast! Today's expected to be cloudy on the mountain with a top of 3 degrees. Winds will be strong, blowing west to north-westerly 50 to 70 km/h, decreasing to 25 to 35 km/h in the evening. Fingers crossed, we'll also hopefully see some snow showers develop later today!

There are 49 groomed runs open for Monday laps. Conditions on the slopes will be firm and fast underfoot, and visibility may be impacted by cloud, so please take care while skiing and boarding.

With strong winds expected today, there may also be an impact on lift operations. 33 lifts are scheduled to spin, but please keep an eye on the lift report for real-time updates or download the Perisher App to stay in the loop!

If you're an Epic Australia Pass holder looking to refresh your snow gear, today is your final chance to shop the Double Discount Sale and score 30% off hardgoods, outerwear and clothing at Slopestyle and Perisher Sports.
